description: Exact tree search with admissible upper bounds computed via relaxed bipartite matching, pruning provably suboptimal subtrees.
Constraint satisfaction solver utilizing forward checking, arc-consistency domain pruning, and conflict-directed backtracking.

Uniform random sampling across the unconstrained table universe to benchmark statistical superiority of directional optimizers.
